characters.summary: Crono is Chrono Trigger's silent swordsman protagonist. His magic is Lightning (Heaven in Japanese), including Luminaire and the revive spell Life, and he forms dual and triple techs with his party. He died against Lavos and was brought back with the Chrono Trigger.

techniques: Luminaire: massive lightning damage to all enemies (20 MP)
Dual and triple techs with allies, e.g. X-Strike with Frog, Delta Force

mechanisms: Not established by the cited sources

weaknesses: Was killed when he confronted Lavos alone to save his companions
mobility: Travels through time with his party via time gates and the Epoch time machine

sources.supports: Silent protagonist, Lightning/Heaven magic, solo techs (Cyclone, Slash, Lightning, Lightning 2, Spincut, Life, Confuse, Luminaire), dual and triple techs, death against Lavos and revival with the Time Egg
Plot: Crono killed by Lavos, revived with the Chrono Trigger; party defeats Magus, Dalton atop the Epoch, and finally destroys Lavos; time gates and the Epoch

campaignTags.claim: Lightning, Lightning 2 and Luminaire deal lightning damage
His Life tech revives a KO'd ally

unknowns: His weapon (katanas) is not named on the opened pages.
Crono's revival is part of the story path in the summary; whether he must be present for the final Lavos fight is not stated.

Charge: a dash that deals heavy damage
Elder Blood outburst (a magical scream at Kaer Morhen)

weaknesses: Avallac'h stunned her with a sleeping spell
mobility: Opens portals to other worlds and dimensions
limitations: Cannot cast signs, drink potions, parry or use strong attacks, and lacks witcher senses

mobility: Glides on his own with Heli-Pack propellers
Lets Ratchet glide, boost jump and stretch jump

Gadgetron Heli-Pack upgrade gives Clank propellers; Clank glides alone and lets Ratchet glide, boost jump and stretch jump
Giant Clank fights Drek until Drek's mech reverts him; Ratchet and Clank destroy Drek's mech and the Deplanetizer

techniques: The Buster Sword, an enormous sword that can cut almost anything in two

mechanisms: Not established by the cited sources

weaknesses: Sephiroth manipulated him: he lost control, handed over the Black Materia and attacked Aerith
His false memories left him unstable; he was found comatose from Mako poisoning
mobility: Not established by the cited sources

sources.supports: Claimed SOLDIER past vs. infantryman truth, Zack's Buster Sword, losing control and handing over the Black Materia, Mako poisoning coma, one-on-one defeat of Sephiroth, Advent Children rematch, Omnislash as his FFVII Limit Break
Mercenary "who will take any job"; his enormous sword can cut almost anything in two

notableResults.note: Sephiroth reappeared in Cloud's mind a final time and was defeated one-on-one

characters.continuity: Mass Effect trilogy (Mass Effect, Mass Effect 2, Mass Effect 3)
characters.summary: Commander Shepard is a Systems Alliance N7 veteran and the first human Spectre. Depending on class Shepard uses biotics, tech or weapons. Shepard stopped Saren and destroyed Sovereign, was killed by the Collectors and revived by Cerberus, and rallied the galaxy against the Reapers.

techniques: Soldier: thorough weapons training, all special ammo and grenades
Vanguard: biotic charge that hits with incredible force
Adept: micro-singularity that lifts and damages enemies
Infiltrator: cloak and sniper rifle with time-slowing scope

mechanisms: Sentinel: an advanced shield that can be detonated to blast nearby enemies

weaknesses: Was killed when the Collectors attacked and destroyed the Normandy (Mass Effect 2 prologue)
limitations: Abilities depend on the chosen class

sources.supports: N7 veteran, first human Spectre, Normandy command, stopping Saren and destroying Sovereign, death to the Collectors and Cerberus revival, Reaper invasion
Mass Effect 3 classes and their powers: Adept singularity, Vanguard biotic charge, Engineer drones, Infiltrator cloak, Soldier weapons, Sentinel shield

feats.claim: Stopped Saren and the Geth, destroyed Sovereign and saved the Citadel

notableResults.note: The opened page does not describe how Saren died
Killed when the Collectors destroyed the Normandy; revived by Cerberus

conditional.dependsOn: Playing an Adept, Vanguard or Sentinel

campaignTags.claim: Biotics are a canonical class option (Adept, Vanguard, Sentinel); owner ruling grants psychic

unknowns: Canon class and moral choices are player-determined.
Infiltrator cloak and Engineer drones are class options; no stealth or tech tags are proposed without an owner ruling.

He then defeats Arkham alongside Vergil and beats Vergil in the Demon World. His styles and Devil Trigger raise his attack and defense and slowly restore health.

Cerberus (devil arm from the defeated Cerberus)
